purpose: Goal wrap-up fixture: an autonomous round marks the goal complete; the tool result carries the generated <goal_complete> additional context, the loop splices it into the next step, the model writes the closing message, and the turn ends completed.

recordingDerived.note: The complete sequence (update_goal call, goal/change complete, tool/result, next-step splice, wrap-up user/message, closing assistant message, turn/end completed) is derived from this recording. The fixture shortens it to the first round.

openIssues: The recorded wrap-up source carries a UI-only summary (complete: <objective>); the native wrap-up omits it because it is not model-visible. This is a known divergence.
The recording logs an agent/inbox/spliced next-step insertion for the wrap-up; the fixture host logs it from the tool result, matching the recorded order.
